biomarkers.name: H3K27me3 loss
biomarkers.prevalence: ~40-80% (more frequent in high-grade than low-grade MPNST)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic marker (correlates with PRC2 complex loss  EED/SUZ12 alterations)

biomarkers.name: NF1 (germline or somatic)
biomarkers.prevalence: Germline NF1  lifetime MPNST risk ~8-13%; ~40-50% of MPNST arise in NF1 setting
biomarkers.clinical_use: Screen NF1 patients; genetic counselling; family screening

biomarkers.name: CDKN2A/B loss
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common secondary alteration; associated with malignant progression and explored in CDK4/6 inhibitor trials

biomarkers.name: S100 (partial/patchy)
biomarkers.prevalence: Often focal/patchy; diffuse staining is uncommon compared with schwannoma
biomarkers.clinical_use: Loss of diffuse S100 supports MPNST vs benign schwannoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Fascicles of spindle cells with alternating hypercellular and hypocellular areas, wavy nuclei, and perivascular whorls; heterologous elements in some
histomorphological_subtype.grading: FNCLCC high-grade typically; low-grade MPNST rare

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Herringbone or fascicular architecture; perivascular whorls; alternating cellular densities

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Schwann cells or neural crest-derived precursors of peripheral nerve sheath
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neural crest  same lineage as schwannoma but with malignant biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Schwannian differentiation partially retained (S100+ often patchy, SOX10 variable) but with high-grade sarcomatous phenotype; H3K27me3 loss is characteristic diagnostic marker
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: PRC2 complex (SUZ12, EED) loss releases H3K27 methylation  distinctive gene expression programme; MPNST arising from plexiform neurofibroma represents NF1-driven progression from benign to malignant peripheral nerve sheath biology
